about_the_game:
Gravity is just a suggestion.

You wake up in a Daedalus Industries mining facility medbay near the moon Titan with chaos unfolding around you and a strange barcode on your wrist. Lost and confused, your only lifeline is "Z", a mysterious faceless figure who is asking for your help.

Master dynamic gravity mechanics that let you walk on walls, flip orientation mid-combat, and navigate complex multi-directional environments. Use physics-based movement to outmaneuver gravity-bound enemies, manipulate objects, and push foes around the battlefield and into environmental traps.

Journey across multiple distinct locations - from the abandoned mining facility where you awaken to the utopian colony ship Talos VII. Piece together the truth behind your missing memories while following the enigmatic guidance of "Z."

Experience classic retro FPS action with a modern twist. Fast-paced combat, environmental storytelling, and secrets waiting to be discovered. Coming 2026.

Features:

  • Dynamic gravity - manipulate gravity to walk on walls and ceilings while (most) enemies stay grounded

  • Physics-based combat - push enemies and manipulate environmental objects

  • Classic retro FPS gameplay - fast-paced combat with weapons that pack a punch

  • Unique weapon and ability mod system - Discover rare weapon and ability modifications hidden in secret locations; increase firing rates, add new secondary attacks, gain double jump ability and more.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 560

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: In this fast-paced retro FPS, you awaken in a Daedalus Industries mining facility near the moon Titan with nothing but the gun in your hand and a barcode on your wrist. Manipulate gravity while exploring mind-bending levels as you fight to escape with the help of a mysterious ally known only as 'Z'.
